name: Validation object binding corrective pass
purpose: Bind validation checks to the object and source labels in their artifacts so symbolic baselines, deterministic fixtures, prompt-hidden probes, and regenerated legacy scaffolds cannot substitute for core evidence.

code_added_used.change: Stage A G1 now requires operator_type=learned_recurrent; symbolic_baseline is a separate harness-control check. L4 checks require source=autonomous_stage_a_run with run_id and real grid cells. W3.1 checks require measured_object=cached_gdn_recurrent_state. Legacy scaffold files are archived_or_absent_ok instead of required-present evidence. A meta-check fails validation while autonomous Stage A cells are zero.
Added explicit operator_type=string labels and fixture source metadata for future Sudoku6 diagnostic artifacts.
Added explicit measured_object labels for prompt-hidden W3 probes so validation can reject them as the wrong object.
Removed whitelisting for regenerated legacy scaffold result JSON files while keeping the real TTT diagnostic.

commands.purpose: Confirmed the validation registry re-reddens the wrong-object checks instead of reporting all-green.

provenance.legacy_scaffold_policy: results/two_by_two, results/d_stage_1, results/d_stage_2, results/d_stage_3, and results/verifier regenerated scaffold outputs deleted; results/ttt retained

rows.required_object_or_source: capacity table uses true recurrent-state matrix dims
survival measured after pushing into cached GDN recurrent state
native-rule gap measured on cached GDN recurrent state

falsified constructed-true scaffold artifacts are not required evidence

honesty.does_not_establish: This corrective item does not train the learned recurrent operator, does not produce autonomous Stage A cells, and does not redo W3 on cached GDN recurrent state. It deliberately turns the registry red until those objects exist.
limitations: T2 learned recurrent training remains future work.
T3 true cached recurrent-state probing remains future work.
Validation counts may change as later checks are added, but the object-binding failures are intentional.
